h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panaji

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panaji

items.pText: Goa's heavy monsoon runs from June to September, and in Panaji that shapes when a playground can be built. Digging, grouting and laying flooring in steady rain is slow and the concrete does not set well. Hotels, resorts and schools in and around the capital usually plan their installation for the dry months, so the play area is ready when the tourist season or the school term begins.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 440 km from Panaji, and sends it down the coast by road. Our installation team or a dealer installs it. Salt air along the Mandovi is hard on bare steel, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Tell us your site size, the age group and your target opening date, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Timing the installation around the monsoon

c: Work backwards from the date you want the play area open. Leave time to approve the layout and the quote, for us to manufacture and dispatch, and for installation in dry weather. A hotel that wants its play area ready for the season should start talking to us well before the rains end.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed in Goa during the monsoon?
items.a: It is possible on some sites, but heavy rain slows the work and affects grouting. Most buyers in Panaji plan the installation for the dry months.

items.q: What equipment suits a resort or hotel in Goa?
items.a: A feature structure for older children, plus swings and spring riders for small ones. We will suggest pieces that match the space and the look of the property.

items.q: Do you supply the rest of Goa as well as Panaji?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to sites across Goa, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.
